# Meridiant

> Isolated-market lending engineered for Canton Network. Every market is its own contract — one collateral, one loan asset, one oracle, one interest-rate curve — so risk never cascades between markets. Positions are private by default, settlement is atomic, and collateral stays borrower-owned.

Meridiant is live on Canton mainnet and invite-only today: the app hosts your Canton party and signing key, and self-custodial wallet signing is the next step.

Meridiant is a trade name of Catalyst Labs L.L.C-FZ, Dubai, U.A.E.

## Canonical pages

- [Homepage](https://meridiant.xyz/): product overview, design principles, market anatomy, why Canton.
- [App](https://app.meridiant.xyz/): the lending venue on Canton mainnet (invite-only).
- [Docs](https://docs.meridiant.xyz/): high-level documentation, not a protocol specification.

## Docs

- [What is Meridiant](https://docs.meridiant.xyz/docs/intro): one-sentence definition, who it is for, what you can do.
- [Why Canton](https://docs.meridiant.xyz/docs/why-canton): need-to-know privacy, atomic composition, sub-second finality, institutional participants.
- [How it works](https://docs.meridiant.xyz/docs/how-it-works): the over-collateralized lending loop.
- [Markets](https://docs.meridiant.xyz/docs/markets): what an isolated market is and how one is parameterized.
- [Supplying](https://docs.meridiant.xyz/docs/supplying), [Borrowing](https://docs.meridiant.xyz/docs/borrowing), [Liquidation](https://docs.meridiant.xyz/docs/liquidation): user flows.
- [Prices and rates](https://docs.meridiant.xyz/docs/prices-and-rates): oracle freshness and utilization-based interest.
- [Privacy and trust](https://docs.meridiant.xyz/docs/privacy-and-trust): what the operator can and cannot do; how to read "non-custodial".
- [Who's involved](https://docs.meridiant.xyz/docs/who-is-involved): suppliers, borrowers, liquidators, operator, oracle, issuers.
- [What we are building](https://docs.meridiant.xyz/docs/what-we-are-building): current state and product path.
- [Getting started](https://docs.meridiant.xyz/docs/getting-started): the invite-only access model.
- [Glossary](https://docs.meridiant.xyz/docs/glossary)

## Agent data API (x402)

- [x402 data API](https://x402.meridiant.xyz/v1/catalog): pay-per-call market, oracle, liquidation and quote data for agents, 0.01 USDCx per call over x402 on Canton MainNet. Discovery file: [llm.txt](https://meridiant.xyz/llm.txt).
